results.title: Emissary Partners Announces Four Senior Advisors, Strengthening International Family Office and Diplomatic Capability
results.description: Emissary Partners, the global advisory firm specialising in complex cross-border situations for family offices, today announced the appointment of Guy Hudson, Kristen Katulis, Brian Katulis and Hyuktae Kwon as senior advisors.

results.title: ITM Power advances 150MW refinery hydrogen project
results.description: ITM Power's Hydropulse subsidiary has advanced European refinery hydrogen plans. A preliminary agreement covers 150MW of electrolysis, with a final investment decision targeted for 2027 and production planned for 2029. results.title: EnergyX signs binding $2bn lithium supply deal with Trafigura
results.description: Lithium startup EnergyX said on Monday it has signed a $2-billion binding offtake to supply commodities trader Trafigura with the battery metal from Chile and the US, one of the largest deals ever tied to direct lithium extraction technology. results.title: PM GatiShakti completes 5 years, next phase focuses on multimodal connectivity: Piyush Goyal
results.description: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal on Tuesday said the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan would continue to support multimodal connectivity, faster infrastructure development and greater logistics efficiency as the initiative completed five years.
